content.text:
Handoffs let an agent delegate a conversation or task to another agent, enabling multi‑step, agentic workflows. You define which agents can hand off to which others by setting a list of agent IDs in the `handoffs` field when creating or updating an agent.

**Yes**, an agent that has its own tools (for example, built‑in tools like `web_search` or `code_interpreter`, or custom function tools) can hand off to another agent. The documentation shows examples where agents equipped with tools are explicitly configured to hand off to other agents, such as the `web_search_agent` and `ecb_interest_rate_agent` handing off to `graph_agent` or `calculator_agent`.

[Handoffs](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/agents/handoffs) 
[Define Handoffs Responsibilities](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/agents/handoffs#define-handoffs-responsibilities) 
[How it Works](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/agents/handoffs#how-it-works)
